package.name: perception_msgs
package.description: HeightScanMessage and its dependencies (Vector2, PackedElementField). This is the canonical definition - the controller side (HeightScanTerm, in ihmc-closed-source-control) and PerceptionAPI (in ihmc-communication) both depend on ihmc-robot-data-logger and reference this package directly, rather than a separate copy living in ihmc-open-robotics-software.
